about_the_game:
Bros Survivors is a 2-player co-op action roguelite where you and your friend must coordinate to survive hordes of zombies, orcs, golems, aliens, robots, and more. Combine powers, annoy each other, or fuse into a single entity to overcome every challenge.

Features:

  • Local co-op for 2 players.

  • Fuse into a single, more powerful character: one controls vertical movement, the other horizontal.

  • Dash to get closer, push, or bother your friend.

  • Waves lasting 20 to 90 seconds packed with enemies.

  • Automatic or manual shooting for each power.

  • Unlock characters with unique abilities.

  • Permanent upgrades in the shop to enhance powers.

  • Fast matches under 30 minutes.

  • Different maps with varied enemies and a final boss.

  • Shared experience: teamwork is essential.

  • Revive your teammate anytime by finding the golden orb.

  • Play solo and let a second player join at any time.

  • Support for joystick and keyboard.

  • Face sci-fi enemies, zombies, and fantasy creatures.

short_description: Team up with a friend to survive waves of enemies! Zombies, monsters, and aliens: the entire multiverse is against you! Bros Survivors is a 2-player co-op action roguelite where you can combine powers and fuse together to survive.
